title: security.refresh_reuse_detected (v2)
description: A rotated refresh token was presented again (possible token theft). Emitted the first time an already-rotated refresh token is presented by the client it was issued to. The refresh family is marked compromised, the grant is revoked and, for session-bound online grants, the session is revoked as well (session.revoked with reason "refresh_reuse"). org_id is set when the grant was bound to an organization. The worker also logs and counts every security.* event as an alertable signal.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

subject_id.description: The grant's subject (user or service principal).

organization_id.description: Set only when the event is bound to an organization (see description).
